shots.headline: Hastaneyi hareket ettir
shots.sub: Ön kapıdan servis yatağına hasta akışı
shots.scene: Town Hospital mid-shift (~11:00), Medium tier, campus cutaway with walking staff, bays and general ward busy, corridors mostly calm, HUD with stars and cash

shots.headline: Her girişi etiketle
shots.sub: Yeşil, sarı, turuncu, kırmızı: renk + şekil
shots.scene: Triage card open on a new walk-in: the four colour buttons with their shapes, a short queue at the front desk behind

shots.headline: Asıl darboğazı bul
shots.sub: Merceğe dokun, nedeni tek satırda oku
shots.scene: Bottleneck lens sheet open naming 'Discharges wait'; the matching corridor glows red in the diorama

shots.headline: Ambulans kararı ver
shots.sub: Bonusu al ya da dolu acili koru
shots.scene: Ambulance call banner with Accept / Divert and the minutes-to-answer counter, ambulance at the bay, red-tag shape icon

shots.headline: Zorluklarla başa çık
shots.scene: Announced crisis running (flu week or highway crash): crisis card, busy orange/red corridors, surge team called (no rewarded-ad button in frame)

shots.headline: Doğru ekipleri kur
shots.sub: Hemşire, doktor, hamal, temizlikçi ve daha fazlası
shots.scene: Teams sheet open with all six teams, their counts and hire buttons; the lens chip above names the team that is short

shots.headline: City General'a büyü
shots.scene: Wide zoom-out of all three wings open: operating room, ICU, surgical ward and lift lit; 'City General is open!' toast

shots.headline: Devret, yıldızını kazan
shots.sub: Vardiyada bakım, bekleme ve akış için dokuz yıldız
shots.scene: Shift report after a good day: star rows for care / waits / flow, treated count, net cash and the next-shift button (no rewarded-ad button in the frame)
